scheme_name: IASRI Scholarship For M.Sc And Ph.D
other_conditions: Minimum residential requirement of 2 academic years from the date of admission
Maximum time limit for completion of the M.Sc. programme is 4 years (2 years for agricultural stream, 3 years for non‑agricultural stream)

Applicants must hold a B.Sc. degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Forestry/Agroforestry/Sericulture/Agricultural Marketing or a 10+2+3 system B.Sc. with at least 60% marks for general category or 55% for SC/ST/PH candidates
Age is reckoned as of 31 July of the year of admission
Foreign student applicants must be sponsored by the Government of India/DARE/ICAR and apply through their respective embassies or Indian missions abroad
Foreign students are exempted from the written test and interview; admission is based on biodata and professor recommendation
benefits_summary: Scholarship of Rs.7,500 per month plus a contingent grant of Rs.6,000 per annum for eligible M.Sc. students.
